summary.text: Charlie Tautuaa is an Unaffiliated write-in candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 52, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Republican Cory Maloy and Democrat Nicole Melling.
Ballotpedia says Tautuaa served in the U.S. Army and has worked in law enforcement, as a caregiver in the medical field, and as a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Tautuaa sought the Republican nomination for District 52 at the April 18, 2026, Republican convention, where incumbent Cory Maloy received 84 votes (86.6%) to Tautuaa's 13 (13.4%).
In the 2024 general election for governor of Utah, Tautuaa was an Unaffiliated write-in candidate and received 525 votes.

Tautuaa's 2024 campaign website, as quoted by Ballotpedia, proposed mandatory retirement for elected officials who reach retirement age and a limit of two consecutive terms within eight years for most elected offices.
